pure-announcement.rationale: It is a repository README describing what the repo contains, not a launch, release-note or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: No nearest concept covers OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions; the closest are unrelated format standards like CycloneDX and OSV.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Everything stated is directly verifiable in the public repository it describes.

durability.rationale: Its one fact — GenAI semantic conventions now live in a dedicated repo extending core semconv via Weaver — should persist, but the note is early-stage scaffolding whose schema URL is literally TODO, so its specifics are likely to churn.

actionability.rationale: It only tells an instrumentation author where the conventions and reference implementations now live; no actual convention content a builder could apply appears in the note itself.

atomicity.rationale: It carries exactly one small idea — a dedicated home for GenAI, MCP and provider-specific telemetry conventions — trivially stateable in a paragraph.
